# script role

The functional role a writing system plays for a language in a usage (a gmeow:ScriptRole value). Functional: one role per usage — a script playing two roles is two usages.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scriptRole>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:scriptRole`  

**Type:** `owl:FunctionalProperty`, `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/languages>
